title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Program Analysis, Part III: Mostly Harmless LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2606.15122v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Filtering out a static-analysis warning asserts that no feasible execution can trigger the reported error, whereas confirming a bug requires only one that does. Recent work uses LLMs to filter out warnings. However, LLM-generated explanations alone cannot establish that the reported error is impossible, and mistakenly filtering out a warning conceals a real bug. Sound static analysis can provide this guarantee, but scalable analyses leave behind the very warnings we seek to filter, whereas sufficiently precise whole-program analysis is impractical. Fortunately, analyzing a small part of the program is often enough to show that a warning is a false alarm. We therefore assign LLMs a different role: rather than judging the validity of warnings, they identify relevant code and construct a harness that supplies the context needed for precise, targeted static analysis.   We present Evident, which combines LLMs with the static analyzer Fram

translated_title: 程序分析漫游指南（三）：基本无害的大语言模型
translated_abstract: 过滤掉一条静态分析警告意味着断言不存在任何可行的执行路径能够触发所报告的错误，而确认一个缺陷只需要找到一条能够触发的执行路径。近期的工作使用大语言模型（LLM）来过滤警告。然而，仅凭LLM生成的解释无法证明所报告的错误不可能发生，而错误地过滤掉一条警告会掩盖真实的缺陷。健全的静态分析可以提供这种保证，但可扩展的分析会遗漏我们想要过滤的那些警告，而足够精确的全程序分析又不切实际。幸运的是，只需分析程序的一小部分往往就足以证明一条警告是误报。因此，我们赋予LLM一个不同的角色：它们不再判断警告的有效性，而是识别相关代码并构建一个测试驱动（harness），为精确的、有针对性的静态分析提供所需的上下文。我们提出了Evident，它将LLM与静态分析器Fram...
tldr: 论文提出Evident系统，让LLM不再直接判断静态分析警告的真伪，而是通过识别相关代码并构建测试驱动（harness）来支持精确的针对性静态分析，从而可靠地过滤误报。
en_tdlr: Evident assigns LLMs a new role: rather than judging static-analysis warnings themselves, LLMs identify relevant code and construct harnesses that enable precise, targeted static analysis to reliably filter out false alarms.
